name: WF-365 — Negotiation Strategy → Revised Offer / Walk-Away / Contract Decision Controller

parameters.jsCode: const i=$input.first().json||{};const now=new Date().toISOString();const dealId=i.deal_id||i.dealId;const leadId=i.lead_id||i.leadId;const propertyId=i.property_id||i.propertyId;const strategy=i.negotiation_strategy||{};const decision=String(i.decision||strategy.decision||'review_required').toLowerCase();const mao=Number(i.adjusted_mao??strategy.adjusted_mao??i.current_mao??0);const ask=Number(i.seller_ask??strategy.seller_ask??i.counteroffer_amount??0);const dnc=Boolean(i.dnc||i.do_not_contact);const blockers=Array.isArray(i.blockers)?i.blockers:[];const signed=Boolean(i.contract_signed||i.executed_agreement||i.signature_completed);let route='human_control',outcome='review_required',reason='decision_requires_review',revisedOffer=0;if(dnc){outcome='stop';reason='dnc';}else if(blockers.length){outcome='blocked';reason='deal_blocker';}else if(!dealId||!leadId||!propertyId){route='reconciliation';reason='missing_identity';}else if(signed){route='contract';outcome='contract_ready';reason='agreement_already_executed';}else if(decision==='advance_negotiation'||decision==='evaluate_counteroffer'||decision==='negotiate_within_mao'){if(mao>0&&ask>0){revisedOffer=Number(Math.min(ask,mao).toFixed(2));route='offer';outcome=revisedOffer>=ask?'accept_or_contract':'revised_offer';reason=revisedOffer>=ask?'ask_within_mao':'protect_mao';}else{route='offer';outcome='request_underwriting';reason='missing_mao_or_ask';}}else if(decision==='protect_mao_or_walk'){route='walk_away';outcome='walk_away_or_reengage';reason='counteroffer_exceeds_strategy';}else if(decision==='reengage_or_close'){route='reengagement';outcome='reengage';reason='seller_rejection';}else if(decision==='schedule_or_human_call'){route='human_control';outcome='human_negotiation';reason='seller_requested_call';}else{route='human_control';outcome='review_required';}const key=(i.strategy_idempotency_key||[dealId,leadId,propertyId,decision,mao,ask].join(':'))+':decision';return[{json:{...i,workflow_id:'WF-365',status:'decision_ready',route,outcome,reason,deal_id:dealId,lead_id:leadId,property_id:propertyId,base_mao:Number(i.base_mao||0),adjusted_mao:mao,seller_ask:ask,revised_offer:revisedOffer,offer_strategy:{outcome,reason,revised_offer:revisedOffer,ma_o_protected:true,walk_away_threshold:mao,requires_human_approval:route==='human_control'},decision_idempotency_key:key,processed_at:now,crm_activity:{type:'negotiation_offer_contract_decision',workflow_id:'WF-365',outcome,reason,revised_offer:revisedOffer,adjusted_mao:mao,seller_ask:ask}}}];
